annual.label: Average yearly repair and maintenance cost (RepairPal)

maint.job: Synthetic oil and filter change (Audi/VW-spec oil)
maint.every: Every 5,000-10,000 miles or once a year
maint.note: Use oil meeting the Audi/VW 502, 507 or 508 spec for your engine.
S3 and RS 3 brakes cost more.
Cars with an electronic parking brake need a scan tool to retract it.
Newer cars need the battery coded with a scan tool.

maint.job: Spark plugs (set of 4, or 6 for the V6)
maint.every: About every 40,000 miles on turbo engines
maint.note: Diesel TDI models have no spark plugs.

maint.job: Engine coolant drain and refill (Audi G13 type)
maint.every: Check yearly; replace about every 5-10 years
maint.note: Use only the coolant type Audi specifies.
